gradient_semantics.description: A next-dollar rate is the composed right-hand derivative of the selected public output with respect to every graph node written by one public input.
gradient_semantics.input_nodes: inputs[name].federal_nodes plus jurisdiction.input_nodes[year][name] plus active derived-input nodes

limitations.summary: Only tax years 2024 and 2025 are supported by the browser contract.
Dependent counts and dependent-related federal credits are outside the initial browser contract.
State-specific adjustment and exemption aggregates are excluded until they have state-specific public concepts.
Results estimate modeled income taxes before payments and refundable credits; they are not filing advice.
